question:
New technologies and ways of buying and selling are transforming the lives of the consumer.
To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
New technologies, in particular the internet, have turn the ways of purchasing and selling into the virtual ones. The buyers’ lifestyle therefore has been changed greatly. I strongly agree with the fact that online buying has become a mainstream activity due to cutting-edge technologies, and it benefits individuals across the globe. In this essay, I will state two significant reasons to defend my perspective.

The first main reason is that in recent years, buyers prefer to purchase virtually everything and easily browse various websites to find their desired goods and services. It is extremely time-saver as they do not have to travel long distances to reach real stores or even brick-and-mortar stores, and allocate too much time to find what they want. Therefore, up-to-dated technologies and technological devices facilitate individuals with virtual purchasing and online ordering at their comfortable zones without pressure from sales assistants.

Another significant reason is that purchasing online could connect buyers to the global market. The individuals therefore do not have to buy goods and services from domestic market. Moreover, the internet provides other price comparison websites for the consumers which enable them to find real bargains. For instance, Amazon is a prominent and well-known website globally which offers not only everything online but also price comparison. This means that shoppers can become more astute and knowledgeable about the products they are purchasing.

All things considered, online shopping has changed into a thriving market and many people strive to find their products and order online rather than traveling to the local stores. Personally, I believe that online shopping facilitates individuals with not only world-wide market but also the real bargains.
